rationale: Continue torch_toto2 HP sweep — 3rd claude iter completes a 2-D characterization of the (context_length, horizon, head_hidden) lever family: #2008 (ctx=512/hor=64/head=128) wp=1 +9.5% with W4 PASS + alive W2 thr=0.55 (miss 0.1pp); #2009 (ctx=256/hor=32/dec=128) wp=2 +2.0% with W1+W4 but lost W2; #2010 (ctx=512/hor=96) wp=1 -0.7% only W4 (W2 sweep collapsed); pre-existing headhidden256 trial also killed W2. The (ctx, hor, head) lever shifts dispersion BETWEEN windows; it cannot ADD dispersion globally. Train mode should now PIN (ctx=512, hor=64, head_hidden=128, pos_weight=1.5) and sweep ORTHOGONAL axes: dropout (0.05–0.35), weight_decay (1e-5..1e-3), learning_rate (3e-4..3e-3), epochs ∈ {15,40}, decode_block_size=64 (only 256 tested at ctx=512), grad_clip (0.5..2.0), and channel_indices subsets (5/6 channels from default-7). Goal: produce alive threshold sweeps in W3/W5/W6/W7 that match what defaults produced in W2. If 2 more iters (i.e. claude attempts 4 and 5) fail to lift wp above 2, mark brief exhausted per directive's threshold.
